pack_facts.text: 374Water wraps up mobile AirSCWO campaign for Minnesota PFAS project: 374Water Inc (NASDAQ:SCWO, FRA:8LL) has completed its mobile AirSCWO contract in St. Cloud, Minnesota, wrapping up a four-phase, multi-feedstock campaign aimed at destroying PFAS and other organic ...

374Water's Mobile AirSCWO System Completes Phase 3 of the St. Cloud, MN ...: Beyond the St. Cloud project, 374Water's solutions team continues to develop follow-on mobile deployments designed to demonstrate the full commercial capabilities of AirSCWO in a mobile configuration.

374Water Completes $600,000 Waste Destruction Services in St. Cloud, MN: Beyond the St. Cloud project, 374Water's solutions team continues to develop follow-on mobile deployments. The Company is currently in discussions regarding a potential follow-on deployment of the mobile AirSCWO system at a prominent industrial project following completion of the Minnesota campaign.
374Water Completes $600,000 Waste Destruction Services in St. Cloud, MN: 374Water completed all four phases of its $600,000 St. Cloud, MN mobile AirSCWO PFAS destruction contract.

374Water Completes $600,000 Waste Destruction Services in St. Cloud, MN: The Company is currently in discussions regarding a potential follow-on deployment of the mobile AirSCWO system at a prominent industrial project following completion of the Minnesota campaign.

374Water Completes $600,000 Waste Destruction Services in St. Cloud, MN: 374Water completes all four phases of its $600,000 mobile AirSCWO contract in St. Cloud, successfully processing four distinct PFAS-laden waste feedstocks. 374Water completes its St. Cloud AirSCWO campaign with no operational issues across four feedstocks, with detailed PFAS destruction results expected in the coming weeks.
